flora: Kauri Cone (globose/spherical, green-to-brown, scales that disintegrate at maturity)
Kauri Leaves (broad, leathery, oval-shaped leaves with parallel veins, not needles)
Kauri sapling (sturdy, upright, with a distinct 'mini-pillar' trunk)
Bark detail (smooth, silver-grey bark that flakes off in large 'dinner-plate' scales)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the massive 'pillar' trunk and the unique broad leaves; tactile flaking bark textures; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A spherical green cone; Top-Right: Detail of the broad leathery leaves; Bottom-Left: A sturdy sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the plate-like flaking bark.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, pale green-grey clay with ochre siltstone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to show the smooth, metallic sheen of the silver-grey bark.
